info.title: OfinTech Desk — Embedded Agent Gateway
info.description: Public endpoints for partner backends (integration key) and partner web pages (session token), and the admin endpoints inside Desk. Read-only financial agents over the AG-UI protocol. No production-readiness claim is made by this document.

integrationKey.description: `oei_…` — issued to a workspace admin in Desk; server-side only.

sessionToken.description: `oes_…` — short-lived (default 15 min) token minted by POST /api/embedded/sessions; browser requests must carry an allowed Origin.

deskSession.name: desk_session
deskSession.description: A signed-in Desk user (admin role and a fresh session for writes).

RunAgentInput.description: AG-UI RunAgentInput. Only the last user message is the new turn; `tools` is ignored; tenant/user/role keys in forwardedProps or state are ignored and audited.

subject.description: The end user's id in the partner's system; only a salted hash is stored.

post.summary: Mint a session token for one end user (partner backend)

schema.description: Server-Sent Events: one `data: <AG-UI event JSON>` frame per event (RUN_STARTED, STATE_SNAPSHOT, STEP_STARTED/FINISHED, TEXT_MESSAGE_START/CONTENT/END, TOOL_CALL_START/ARGS/END/RESULT, CUSTOM {name: ofintech.component | ofintech.notice | ofintech.unverified_figures}, RUN_FINISHED {outcome: success | interrupt}, RUN_ERROR). See docs/embedded/AG-UI-PROTOCOL-MAPPING.md.

403.description: Origin not allowed, capability missing, entitlement exceeded or workspace sealed

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The Desk run id from RUN_STARTED.metadata.ofintech.desk_run_id

schema.description: Server-Sent Events: one `data: <AG-UI event JSON>` frame per event (RUN_STARTED, STATE_SNAPSHOT, STEP_STARTED/FINISHED, TEXT_MESSAGE_START/CONTENT/END, TOOL_CALL_START/ARGS/END/RESULT, CUSTOM {name: ofintech.component | ofintech.notice | ofintech.unverified_figures}, RUN_FINISHED {outcome: success | interrupt}, RUN_ERROR). See docs/embedded/AG-UI-PROTOCOL-MAPPING.md.

post.summary: Stop a running or waiting run

get.summary: Agent catalogue, capabilities and default limits

post.summary: Register an integration (admin, fresh session; refused on sealed workspaces)

200.description: Created; the key is shown once

patch.summary: Rename, suspend/activate, change origins, capabilities or limits (admin, fresh session)

delete.summary: Revoke an integration: key, sessions and the service user's membership (admin, fresh session)

post.summary: Rotate the integration key; closes sessions minted with the old key

get.summary: Usage per day, agent and status; today's totals
